findings.claim: R8 still classifies an external-input exception as a programming fault and forbids assigning it a K8 state. A normally returned JSON repository response with default_branch containing a lone surrogate makes current-master nhap_wd raise UnicodeEncodeError (a ValueError subclass) before constructing the ref URL. It is outside the frozen catch set. Thus the new iff rule for external-byte exceptions and the explicit exclusion are contradictory; a conforming executor would propagate this malformed-response failure instead of the required unknown-state/reason/mode result. The executor stop clause does not close the known gap: it names unexpected package/codec exceptions, not malformed REST data.

manifestations.description: REST repository.default_branch → URL encoding: high surrogate, low surrogate and surrogate embedded in an otherwise ordinary name all escape unchanged. These are three input variants of one boundary defect, not three cause classes.

whole_candidate_scan.scope: Entire candidate: I4/I5, U1–U7, K1–K8 graph, §4.3 list/phase mapping/stop rule, §4.5 composition, §5 J/R/S, §6 journal, acceptance 4/5/11/19 and historical closure text; unchanged helper lay_json/lay_trang/tai_noi_dung/nhap_wd; all four supported ZIP codecs on Python 3.11–3.13.
whole_candidate_scan.result: ZIP decoder additions close 21a–21c. The remaining manifestation is the JSON-to-URL conversion of repository.default_branch; the specification’s path-surrogate measurement exercises a different, already caught phase-d path. Coverage/exclusion wording and the missing acceptance/mutant are manifestations of the same incomplete boundary policy, reported once.

evidence.observed_output: On all three runtimes, default_branch containing U+D800, U+DFFF or an embedded U+D800 produces UnicodeEncodeError in the unchanged nhap_wd, at urllib.parse.quote(default_branch). The transport returns (200, JSON bytes) normally. Healthy ASCII and Vietnamese Unicode branch controls return passed. The literal R8 boundary lets UnicodeEncodeError escape. Digest-matched ZIP controls remain valid.

evidence.unmeasured: The extension is an isolated boundary model, not B3 product code. No claim of actual deploy/journal acceptance.

evidence.command: python3 -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/wp1461-r8-independent'); import probe; from collections import Counter; print(Counter(probe.observe(lambda i=i: probe.invoke(probe.archive(),branch=chr(i))).get('name') for i in range(0xd800,0xe000)))"
evidence.observed_output: UnicodeEncodeError: 2048/2048 surrogate code points on Python 3.13.18. master, nhanh-đo and nhanh-😀 controls return passed.

The active exclusion at SPEC.md:145 calls ValueError and all other unlisted classes programming faults, while the same paragraph includes external REST bytes in the policy. Line 161 acknowledges finite coverage but only directs the executor to stop for a different codec class or an unlisted exception from a package. Acceptance 5/11 cover ZIP families and synthetic programming faults, not this REST-to-URL boundary.

suggested_fix.where: SPEC.md §4.3 helper-call policy and measurement/stop paragraph, acceptance 5 and 11, and the r7→r8 closure statement. Eventual adaptation belongs at the nhap_wd call or validated REST boundary in ops/cong_phat_hanh.py, which B3 owns. Do not modify out-of-write-set ops/ci_provenance.py.
suggested_fix.how: Keep the measured codec families and exact-OSError distinction. Give the measured REST Unicode-encoding failure an explicit result policy, either by narrowly recognizing that input failure around the helper or by rejecting the invalid scalar at the owned REST boundary before URL construction. Reconcile the frozen list with the claim that every excluded class is a programming fault; do not turn a finite survey into that universal claim. Extend the executor stop rule to external REST responses as well as ZIP packages. Runnable reproducer and probe-only narrow alternative: probe.py and lock_unicode.py in this review directory. Product-code advice is directional only.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Add a named case using actual ASCII JSON response bytes whose default_branch contains an escaped lone high or low surrogate, with a healthy A4 archive and normally returning transport. Require the complete K8 vector, primary reason, chan rc6/no push and warning_only classification/journal; include valid ASCII, Vietnamese and supplementary-plane branch controls. The mutant removing the narrow input rule must fail that case’s own exception class. KeyError, FileNotFoundError and unrelated AttributeError must remain separate programming-fault/false-credit controls. lock_unicode.py executes the boundary-level distinction: a narrow extension passes, its removal fails UnicodeExternalCase, and unrelated failures earn no kill credit.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Catching all ValueError, UnicodeError or Exception would hide unrelated defects; rejecting all non-ASCII branch names would reject valid Unicode. Duplicate REST reads could introduce snapshot drift. Preserve source-byte/digest binding, exact-OSError handling, phase truthfulness, and the distinction between local model probes and native B3 acceptance.

findings.scope_decision: Malformed-response robustness is expressly in scope: §4.3 names external REST bytes and §5 J specifies malformed-response handling. This is not a claim that GitHub currently hosts an invalid Unicode branch, nor a request to repair the upstream helper. It is a measured contradiction in the new adapter contract.
findings.experiment_performed: Unchanged current-master helper plus independent byte fixtures and isolated boundary/test models; no repository patch.
findings.confidence: high for the measured contract contradiction; live occurrence and actual B3 implementation remain unmeasured
